# cayley-dickson-terrace-frontier (`0TH-2026-019`, `v2.0.0`)

> Zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 six-kernel formalization (22 headline theorems `T1a`–`T4f`, 23 Palomar targets, 35 audited declarations), Rust/ISO C11/Python differential verifiers, interactive WCAG 2.2 AA 3D Canvas observatory, and 21-page AMS-LaTeX white paper proving the Dyadic-Palindromic Terrace Law, Nilpotent Mirror Conservation & Exact Kernel Basis, Dimension-64 Coordinate Right-Multiplier Rupture, Sedenion Triple-42 Duality, Pure-Kernel Pathion Ceiling $r_{\max}(\mathrm{CD}_5) = 14$ with Strict $7+7$ Rigidity, and Dimension-64 Split Interior Spectral Gap.

## Canonical Entry Points
- [README.md](README.md): Overview, quickstart commands, visual preview, and verbatim 35-declaration Lean 4.35.0 `#print axioms` audit.

- [LIMITATIONS.md](LIMITATIONS.md): Explicit epistemic boundaries and open problems not claimed solved.
- [ERRATA.md](ERRATA.md): Complete resolution record of all 23 v1.0.0 audit entries closed in `v2.0.0`.
- [REPLICATION.md](REPLICATION.md): Step-by-step clean-clone reproduction commands.
- [HARDENING_INDEX.md](HARDENING_INDEX.md) & [HARDENING_LOG.md](HARDENING_LOG.md): Three-cycle deep-dive hardening index and changelog.
- [lean/formalization.yaml](lean/formalization.yaml): Machine-readable Lean 4.35.0 proof metadata & 6-kernel manifest.
- [lean/Challenge.lean](lean/Challenge.lean): Statement-only abbreviations `T1aStmt`–`T4fStmt` and `AllTerraceTheoremsStmt`.
